scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bbt/protocol build && pnpm --filter @bbt/server build && pnpm --filter @bbt/web build
scripts.test:stress: pnpm --filter @bbt/server test:stress && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs test --manifest-path companion/Cargo.toml --test stress --release
scripts.benchmark: pnpm --filter @bbt/server benchmark && node scripts/run-cargo.mjs bench --manifest-path companion/Cargo.toml --bench companion_bench
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @bbt/protocol build && pnpm --filter @bbt/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @bbt/web typecheck
scripts.test:mod: node scripts/package-mods.mjs && node scripts/validate-patches.mjs && node scripts/test-mod.mjs
